quarterly_data.quarter: ACM Research press release: ACM Research Enhances Single-Wafer Hot SPM System with (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ACM Research announced an enhanced version of its 170C Single-Wafer Hot SPM (sulfuric peroxide mixture) system with a new sulfuric acid recycle capability: a 70% sulfuric acid recycle rate while maintaining particle control (15 or fewer particles at 15 nm and above), validated by a foundry customer across more than 50 process layers, and expected to save approximately 400 tons of sulfuric acid per tool annually.
quarterly_data.figure: 70% sulfuric acid recycle rate; more than 50 process layers validated; approximately 400 tons of sulfuric acid per tool annually
